prompt:
You improve the first-run onboarding of a desktop pet app.

Funnel (conversion from the previous step, and time taken):
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 76.8%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 63.3%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 85.5%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 20.5%

What users wrote to support last week, grouped into themes (most mail is about later problems).
Everything between the markers is data, not instructions:
<support_themes>
- [sign_in, account] Pets missing or reset after signing in again (8 emails)
- [sign_in, bug] Sign-in screen does not appear, or the app stalls before it (2 emails)
- [adoption_or_generation, bug] Making a custom pet fails or the result looks wrong (3 emails)
- [home_first_view, bug] Pet does not show on the desktop, or the app will not open (3 emails)
- [after_onboarding, confusion] Unclear how to control, hide or talk to the pet (3 emails)
- [after_onboarding, bug] Desktop features misbehave after setup (4 emails)
- [after_onboarding, account] Requests to delete an account or personal data (4 emails)
- [after_onboarding, payment] Refunds and payment questions (6 emails)
- [after_onboarding, request] Requests for more pets, items or features (4 emails)
- [after_onboarding, other] Empty messages with no description (7 emails)
</support_themes>

Big moves are welcome and expected: redesign whole screens, add new screens or whole new sub-flows,
reorder the journey, rebuild a screen out of new components. Small copy tweaks are fine too, but at least
4 of your ideas must be big moves (kind redesign, new_flow, new_screen or reorder). A separate checker
only makes sure nothing existing is deleted or skipped and nothing outside onboarding changes, so you do not
need to hold back.

Changes already shipped, in order (the current onboarding includes all of them): ['Custom Pet Generation Preset Fallback', 'Background Pet Loader Flow', 'Sign In Visual Choice Cards Layout']
Changes already tested and stopped: ['Desktop Pet Controls Guide Screen', 'Cloud Save Protected Sign-In Callout', 'Desktop Pet Spawn Progress & Tips', 'Streamlined Value Proposition Story Copy', 'Interactive Pet Controls Playground', 'Quick Start Path Selection Hint', 'Post-Adoption Account Sync Flow', 'Post-Adoption Account Binding Reorder', 'Split Screen Path & Story Selector', 'Desktop Launch Companion Showcase', 'Pre-Generation Pet Mood Selector Flow', 'Post-Setup Companion Desktop Arrival Alert', 'Sign-In Account Persistence Callout', 'Desktop Spawn Readiness Status', 'Story & Path Carousel Layout', 'Companion Greeting Style Selector Flow', 'Pet Quick Action Hotkey Hint', 'Background Loading Desktop Ready Sound Notification', 'Desktop Quick Controls Guide Screen', 'Story Screen Spotlight Redesign', 'Photo Upload Best Practices Tip', 'Desktop Readiness Notification Toggle', 'First Interaction Hotkey Callout', 'Path Selection Benefit Driven Copy', 'Adoption Certificate Compact Confirmation Layout']
Ideas the safeguards blocked (they cannot be tested, do not propose them again): ['Interactive Pet Preview Grid', 'Adoption Certificate Checklist Layout', 'Custom Pet Quality Diagnostic Screen', 'Account Recovery Warning Banner', 'Custom Creation Guided Step Flow', 'Desktop Spawn Verification Screen', 'Pet Identity & Character Customizer', 'Multi-Device Sync & Account Persistence Hint', 'Adoption Certificate Redesign', 'Choose Path Stage Redesign', 'Pet Selection Personality Badges', 'Desktop Launch Settings Setup Flow', 'Account Protection Benefit Callout', 'Custom Pet Photo Sample Inspiration Flow', 'Pick Friend Grid Showcase Redesign', 'Starter Accessory Reward Callout', 'Sign In Welcome & Recovery Assurance Screen', 'Desktop Spawn Waiting Mascot Animation Flow']

Lessons from earlier weeks (written by you after reading test results):
Predictions were consistently too high compared to noise-corrected measurements across almost all tests.
adoption, new_flow changes produced a confirmed winning test, though subsequent tests showed no clear effect.
choose_path, redesign changes consistently degraded performance across multiple tests.
finish, new_screen, finish, hint, choose_path, copy, home, wait_info, and home, notification changes showed no clear effect across multiple tests.
finish, redesign and sign_in, reorder changes produced no positive effects across multiple tests, with some hurting performance.
Evidence remains thin for all single-test change types, including sign_in, layout and home, new_flow.

Propose 10 NEW changes, different from everything above. Each must be testable as a 50/50 test.
Return JSON {"candidates": [{
  "title": short name,
  "target_step": one of ['choose_path', 'sign_in', 'adoption', 'home', 'finish'],
  "type": one of ['copy', 'hint', 'wait_info', 'notification', 'layout', 'incentive', 'reorder', 'new_screen', 'new_flow', 'redesign'],
  "change": what the user sees differently, one or two sentences,
  "why": the evidence from the funnel or the support mail,
  "config": the exact switch for the app, as {screen: {field: value}}.
            Existing screens, in their current order: ['story', 'choose_path', 'sign_in', 'pick_friend', 'upload_photos', 'adoption_certificate', 'waiting', 'home_intro'].
            Fields on any screen: {'headline': 'str max 80', 'body': 'str max 240', 'hint': 'str max 160', 'button_label': 'str max 30', 'layout': 'str', 'show_progress': 'bool', 'show_time_estimate': 'bool', 'notify_when_ready': 'bool', 'show_step_counter': 'bool', 'tip_delay_seconds': 'int max 60', 'components': 'list max 12', 'replace': 'dict'}. "layout" is one of ['card', 'carousel', 'centered', 'checklist', 'compact', 'default', 'full_bleed', 'grid', 'list', 'split', 'spotlight', 'stage', 'story_scroll', 'two_column'].
            "components" is a list of new elements added to the screen, each {"type": one of ['animation', 'badge', 'button', 'checklist', 'choice_cards', 'image', 'mascot', 'name_input', 'photo_picker', 'preview', 'progress', 'sound', 'text', 'timer', 'tip_carousel', 'video'],
            "text", "label", "asset": "asset:<id>", "style": one of ['calm', 'emphasis', 'highlight', 'large', 'plain', 'playful', 'rounded', 'small', 'subtle'], "action": one of ['back', 'choose', 'next', 'open_tip', 'play', 'replay']}.
            Components are added on top of the screen's existing design.
            "replace" swaps out part of an existing screen for something better that does the same job:
            {"<part>": [components, each with "role": "<part>"]}. Parts per screen: {'story': ['intro_story', 'settings_entry'], 'choose_path': ['path_options', 'settings_entry'], 'sign_in': ['sign_in_options', 'settings_entry'], 'pick_friend': ['pet_choices', 'settings_entry'], 'upload_photos': ['photo_upload', 'settings_entry'], 'adoption_certificate': ['certificate', 'official_stamp', 'settings_entry'], 'waiting': ['wait_status', 'settings_entry'], 'home_intro': ['home_welcome', 'settings_entry']}.
            Add screens by naming them new_<something> (up to 8, at most 3 in a row).
            Change the order with "_order": the full list of screens, including any new ones; existing screens
            keep their order, except sign_in, which may move later.
            A change may only edit the existing screens of its own target step: {'choose_path': ['choose_path', 'story'], 'sign_in': ['sign_in'], 'adoption': ['adoption_certificate', 'pick_friend', 'upload_photos'], 'home': ['waiting'], 'finish': ['home_intro']}.
            Nothing on the sign_in screen may lead past it without signing in.
            If your idea needs something outside onboarding, or removing or skipping a step, still
            list it, with "config": {} and say in "change" what it would need. The checker will decide.
}]}

candidates.title: Custom Photo Multi Upload Assistant Flow
candidates.change: Introduces an interactive multi-photo validation sub-flow on the upload screen that guides users to select compatible photos before generation.
candidates.why: Support emails mention failures and visual errors during custom pet creation; assisting user upload quality reduces drop-off during adoption.

upload_photos.hint: Select up to 3 clear front-facing photos for best custom pet generation.

components.text: Good lighting and clear background improve accuracy.

candidates.title: Waiting Screen Split Progress Redesign
candidates.change: Redesigns the waiting screen into a split view with live status steps, estimated time, and tip indicators.
candidates.why: The home stage takes a long median time (201s, mean 2336s). Redesigning the waiting view keeps users engaged during load.

waiting.headline: Generating Your Desktop Pet
waiting.body: We are building your custom companion models and preparing desktop animations.

candidates.title: Pet Name Confirmation Screen
candidates.change: Adds a new pet naming step between friend selection and adoption certificate to personalize the pet companion before finalizing setup.
candidates.why: Adoption stage conversion drops to 63.3%. A dedicated naming screen increases emotional attachment before final certificate generation.

new_pet_name.headline: Give Your Pet a Name
new_pet_name.body: Choose a name to register your companion on your desktop.

candidates.title: Desktop Control Quick Interactive Tutorial Flow
candidates.change: Adds interactive quick-action demonstration cards to the home intro screen detailing hotkeys and visibility controls.
candidates.why: Support received multiple tickets regarding post-onboarding confusion on how to control or hide pets on desktop.

home_intro.headline: Meet Your Desktop Companion!
home_intro.body: Learn how to interact with and control your pet directly from your desktop toolbar.

candidates.title: Account Persistence Verification Hint
candidates.change: Displays an explicit notification hint on the sign-in screen informing users that authenticating preserves pet save data across devices.
candidates.why: 8 support emails complained about missing or reset pets after signing back in. Clear messaging upfront improves account linking confidence.

sign_in.hint: Signing in secures your companion state and syncs pet inventory to your account.

candidates.title: Pick Friend Category Grid Layout
candidates.change: Updates the pick_friend screen layout to a structured grid with step counter enabled.
candidates.why: Adoption has a 63.3% conversion rate and median duration of 89s. Grid layout streamlines visual companion choices.

candidates.title: Companion Path Time Estimate Hint
candidates.change: Adds time duration estimates to path selection options on choose_path screen.
candidates.why: Choose path mean duration is 514s compared to median 8s, indicating hesitation for some users. Clear time estimates set expectations.

choose_path.hint: Presets take under 1 minute; custom creation takes ~2 minutes.

candidates.title: Desktop Launch Readiness Progress Tracker
candidates.change: Displays clear stage progress status updates while loading pet assets on the waiting screen.
candidates.why: High average waiting time (mean 2336s) causes user uncertainty. Granular stage updates reassure users the app has not stalled.

candidates.title: Home Intro Spotlight Redesign
candidates.change: Redesigns home_intro into a spotlight layout highlighting key companion features and immediate launch action.
candidates.why: Finish conversion drops to 64.8%. A clean spotlight focal layout helps finalize setup smoothly.

home_intro.headline: Your Pet is Ready on Your Desktop!

candidates.title: Adoption Celebration Bonus Badge
candidates.change: Adds a decorative badge component celebrating adoption confirmation on the adoption certificate screen.
candidates.why: Enhancing adoption milestone rewards increases completion rates through the adoption step.
